rows.jp: 「ふう」
rows.en: “Whew.”

rows.jp: テーブルの上に、メモが置かれていた。
rows.en: A note lay on the table.

ghs.en: On the table was laid a memo.

rows.jp: 『夕食あるかも』
rows.en: “Dinner, maybe.”

ghs.assessment: The English memo retains Japanese corner brackets rather than the edition's English quotation treatment.
ghs.remedy: Use the established English styling for a written note.

rows.jp: 「わーい、行く行くー」
rows.en: “Yay! I’m coming, I’m coming!”

rows.jp: 自分で用意しないですんだ。
rows.en: That saved me from having to fix dinner myself.

ghs.en: I don't need to make it myself then.

rows.jp: 三分で着替えると、いそいそと彼女の家に向かうのだった。
rows.en: I changed in three minutes flat and practically skipped over to her place.

ghs.en: I changed my clothes in three minutes then cheerfully headed towards her house.

rows.jp: 夕食は、おいしゅうございました。
rows.en: Dinner was simply divine.

rows.jp: 蝋燭に火をつける。
rows.en: I light a candle.

rows.jp: 照明は使えない。
rows.en: The lights don't work.

rows.jp: いくら俺でも、真っ暗では読み書きは難しい。
rows.en: Even I have trouble reading and writing in pitch darkness.

ghs.en: Even with how I am, reading and writing in complete darkness is difficult.

rows.jp: 独特の輝きが、室内を照らす。
rows.en: Its singular glow fills the room.

ghs.en: A very peculiar radiance illuminates the room.

rows.jp: 蝋燭が好きだった。
rows.en: I've always loved candles.

rows.jp: 生の火に、強く惹かれた。
rows.en: Open flames have always fascinated me.

ghs.en: Their raw flame captivated me so strongly.

rows.jp: こうしてぼんやりと揺らめく炎を見ていると、心が囚われて、いつまでもいつまでもまどろんでいることができた。
rows.en: Watching that dim flame waver, I can lose myself in it and drift half-asleep forever and ever.

ghs.en: When I looked at the flickering flame swaying so absentmindedly, my heart was enraptured and I could just doze off endlessly, endlessly.
ghs.assessment: ぼんやり describes the flame's dim, soft appearance or the viewer's hazy absorption. 'The flame swaying absentmindedly' assigns a human mental state to the flame.
ghs.remedy: Use 'As I gaze at the softly flickering flame...'

highlights.text: When I looked at the flickering flame swaying so absentmindedly, my heart was enraptured and I could just doze off endlessly, endlessly.

rows.jp: 以前、それで前髪を焦がしたこともある。
rows.en: I've even singed my bangs that way before.

ghs.en: Once, I even singed my bangs in it because of that.
ghs.assessment: One singes one's bangs on or over a flame, not 'in it.'
ghs.remedy: Use 'I once even singed my bangs on one.'

highlights.text: Once, I even singed my bangs in it because of that.

rows.jp: ぶっちゃけ三分前のことだ。
rows.en: By “before,” I mean three minutes ago.

ghs.en: OK, that was like three minutes ago.

rows.jp: 「……焦げた……ちくせう」
rows.en: “...They're singed... dagnabbit.”

rows.jp: 泣きそう。
rows.en: I could cry.

ghs.assessment: The English is ungrammatical and removes the narrator as experiencer. The source says he feels as though he might cry.

rows.jp: とにかく日記を書こう。
rows.en: Anyway, time to write in my diary.

rows.jp: ノートを開く。
rows.en: I open my notebook.

rows.jp: 記録は、大切だ。
rows.en: Keeping a record matters.

rows.jp: 巻き戻されたが最後、それだけが確かなものだからだ。
rows.en: Once the world rewinds, this will be the one thing I can trust.

ghs.en: Because the conclusion is rewinding, and that is the only thing that is certain.
